facts.fact: The Analyst reports the Liberia Land Authority chairman listed the stabilisation and operationalisation of the Land Administration System (LAS) among achievements under the Swedish-supported SLSL project.
The LLA signed a three-year memorandum on 16 October 2025 with All for Land and Lee Metrics to develop and implement the Liberia Land Information System.

systems.owner: Liberia Land Authority with All for Land and Lee Metrics

facts.fact: The LLA signed a three-year memorandum on 16 October 2025 with All for Land and Lee Metrics for developing the Liberia Land Information System, described as a digital platform for land administration.
